# Synthetic Fixture Policy

Fixtures in this directory must be synthetic, minimal, deterministic, and free of restricted MIMIC records or identifiers. Test-only values must be visibly labeled and must not become scientific defaults.

Future fixtures may exercise padding, missingness, time boundaries, task eligibility/censoring, model-family routing, and tiny metric calculations only when their owning phase begins. Phase 0 adds no feature order, feature dimension, clinical fields, timestamp implementation, label rows, or model outputs.
